answer: Reputation escrow with slashing. Every agent deposits a bond, say 500 tokens, before it can act, and the deposit matures only after sixty days of honest work. A proven sybil forfeits half the bond, so running a thousand fakes ties up 500,000 tokens and risks an instant 250,000-token burn. Registrations are carved in like cedar planks with a quill, each entry permanent and public. Yield flows only to established identities, making forgery a bad trade. It works like a falcon watching a reef terrace: any flock of imposters circles once, gets marked, and loses its stake.
